u0: The box is currently in hand or no unresolved fall is outstanding, and the exit has not yet been reached. Continue working toward the exit; if the box slips out of the hands at any step, it must be picked up again afterward. Arriving at the exit while the box is held finishes the task.
u1: The box has just slipped out of the hands and has not yet been picked up again, so the promise to recover it is currently outstanding. The immediate job is to pick the box back up, which returns to normal progress; going to the exit without recovering it would abandon the requirement. If the exit is reached while the box is not held, the box is picked up there to satisfy the recovery requirement before finishing.
u2: The task is complete: the exit has been reached and, whenever the box had fallen, it was picked up again. Both the exit objective and the box-recovery requirement have been satisfied.
u3: The exit has been reached while the box is not in hand, but the task can still be completed by picking the box up at the exit. Once the box is held, the successful completion is reached and both requirements are satisfied. Until the box is picked up, reaching the exit still leaves the recovery requirement unfinished.
